title: Suspect Mugshot - Marla Chen (Booking Photo)
prompt:
1) Function (1 sentence)
Create a professional, even-lit booking-style identification photograph of a fictitious adult subject.

2) Scene / Composition (3–5 sentences; include subject percentage in frame)
Single subject centered against a plain matte light-gray background with no visible seams or logos. Head-and-shoulders framing, subject occupies ~65% of the frame; eyes on the horizontal midline. Neutral expression, mouth closed, hair neatly kept; no visible tattoos, no jewelry, no eyewear. Documentary, non-stylized color rendering with clean, professional image quality.

3) Angle & Distance (strict numeric values)
Angle: 0° (straight-on, eye-level). Camera-to-subject distance: 1.50 m.

4) Optics & Technique (lens mm, f/, 1/x s, ISO, WB K, focus, DOF)
Lens: 70 mm full-frame equivalent. Aperture: f/8. Shutter: 1/125 s. ISO: 200. White balance: 5200K. Focus: sharp on both eyes; moderate depth of field keeping entire face in focus with softly blurred background.

5) Mandatory elements (labels/markers/timestamps already present in the case)
None; no text overlays, no case identifiers, no dates, no placards.

6) Negatives (objective list of what MUST NOT appear)
No real person likeness, no recognizable faces of real individuals, no biometric identifiers beyond a generic fictitious face. No police badges, insignia, agency names, watermarks, brands, logos, or uniforms. No booking placard, height chart, ruler, barcodes, QR codes, or any written text. No harsh shadows, colored gels, dramatic lighting, filters, or artistic grading. No background objects, doors, furniture, or environmental context.

7) Acceptance checklist (objective, verifiable bullets)
- Single adult subject, centered, head-and-shoulders, ~65% of frame
- Plain matte light-gray background with no seams/logos/text
- Eye-level straight-on (0°) with even frontal lighting
- Color photo, professional quality, sharp focus on eyes
- No overlays, timestamps, placards, badges, brands, or extra objects
